verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs state that Git Large File Storage is available when enabled on the server and Git is version 2.1.2 or later, so this is a first-party LFS capability. The evidence is a single conditional sentence. missing for 10: details on LFS setup and storage backends, quotas or size limits, web UI handling of LFS objects, and independent or hands-on confirmation that LFS works in practice.
